value.name: analysis
value.value: Online RINE raises average performance by +8.01% accuracy across both recent-generator and in-the-wild benchmarks combined, with particularly strong gains on previously challenging recent generators such as Echo-4o (48.75% → 76.80% accuracy) and Nano-Consistent (63.81% → 71.01% accuracy), while also improving in-the-wild robustness(+1.01% ACC on ITW-SM, +2.39% ACC on MediaEval). Under continual adaptation  Online RINE improves average AUC over its baseline by +3.49% after the first round and reaches its peak by the final round with a +7.36% average AUC gain and +20.14% accuracy improvement on AIGenImages2026, while also strengthening in-the-wild robustness along the way (+3.30% AUC on Deepfake-Eval by the second round). Together, these results confirm that jointly leveraging in-the-wild and generator-driven data within a continual learning strategy allows the model to adapt to newly emerging generators while preserving real-world robustness and avoiding catastrophic forgetting.
value.description: Analysis and explanation of performance results.

value.name: thresholds
value.value:
> Accuracy decision threshold: **0.5**   
> Applied at detector evaluation to compute Accuracy across all benchmarks.

> τ\_anchor: 0.8   
> Applied during fact-check retrieval to select anchor images whose VLM similarity score to extracted textual descriptions meets or exceeds this value.

> τ\_sim: 0.75   
> Applied during fact-check retrieval to expand the anchor set with candidate images whose CLIP ViT-L/14 visual similarity to an anchor image meets or exceeds this value.

> TopK: 500   
> Applied during real–fake pair construction to cap the number of real images retrieved per AI-generated image.

> Segmentation threshold: 0.4   
> Applied during image segmentation with Grounding DINO Tiny to isolate visual regions and remove platform-specific overlays or UI elements.
value.description: If decision thresholds are used, what are they, and why were those parameters chosen?

value.name: methodology
value.value: We evaluate our detector using two complementary metrics: AUC (Area Under the ROC Curve) and ACC (Accuracy). AUC measures overall ranking capability independent of a fixed decision threshold, providing a threshold-agnostic view of discriminative ability. ACC reflects performance at a specific operating point, offering a more practical, deployment-relevant measure.
value.description: Explanation of how metrics are calculated and averaged, with uncertainty measures and evaluation method.

value.name: fairness
value.value: Fairness is defined as invariance of the model's predictions to an image's semantic content, such that classification depends on generation-related forensic artifacts rather than the depicted subject or context. This aims to reduce implicit biases that may cause certain types of content to be systematically classified as more or less likely to be AI-generated.
